summary: A clever free cat visits a warm new home to find food.

sentences.text: In the primordial epoch when the earth was still unscarred by civilization, creation existed in a state of wild and pristine isolation.
Every living creature navigated the untamed expanse alone, answering only to the ancient imperatives of instinct and solitude.
Of all the inhabitants of that nascent world, the cat was by far the most fiercely independent.
To his discerning eye, every geographical boundary was entirely interchangeable, and all spaces possessed an identical, inviting emptiness.
He harbored no interest in the nascent social structures of his fellow beasts, nor in the distant, plotting figures of mankind.
His sole ambition was to roam unhindered through the primeval woods, where every fern and towering oak offered an open invitation.
He spent his diurnal hours darting through the undulating sea of tall grass, tracking the erratic flight of small birds overhead.
The terrestrial realm was a boundless tapestry of wonders, yet he refused to anchor his existence to any single coordinate.
He welcomed the crisp, invigorating chill of the morning air with the same equanimity as the profound stillness of the moonless night.
No external force could dictate his trajectory, for he derived an intense, unalloyed joy from every deliberate step upon the earth.
Then came the pivotal transition when man abandoned the shadowy cavern and stepped out into the open landscape to live with woman.
Together, they carved out a domestic sanctuary, sealing the chill of the wilderness beyond a crude but effective perimeter of stacked stones.
Within this nascent hearth, woman kindled a bright, steady fire that promised warmth against the encroaching shadows of the dark.
It was the wild dog who first breached this boundary, drawn by the undeniable promise of sustenance in exchange for unwavering loyalty.
Man promised him abundant scraps, and in return, the dog readily accepted the solemn duty of guarding the perimeter through the night.
Not long after, the wild horse emerged from the distant horizon, compelled by the seductive prospect of effortless nourishment.
He willingly traded his blistering speed across the open plains for a dependable supply of fresh, tender grass near the dwelling.
Soon followed the wild cow, offering her rich milk to enrich the daily provisions of the newly established family.
With each addition, the domestic sphere grew more prosperous, transforming the precarious struggle for survival into a sustainable routine.
The family rejoiced in their newfound security, possessing milk, meat, and a protective barrier against the unpredictable dangers outside.
Life within the enclosure steadily improved, marked by an orderly rhythm of sunrise labor and sunset repose.
The man and woman worked in tireless harmony, constructing a robust fence that fortified their growing home against the wider world.
They ensured that every subservient creature within their domain was adequately fed, fostering a miniature ecosystem of mutual dependence.
As seasons turned, the physical footprint of the homestead expanded to accommodate their ambitions and their growing peace.
Near the sturdy wooden fence, their children played beneath the afternoon sun, their laughter echoing above the resting animals.
High up in the branches of a spreading oak, the astute cat observed this intricate domestic machinery with cool detachment.
Intrigue finally outweighed his disdain, prompting him to descend from his leafy perch and approach the forbidden threshold.
He padded silently toward the open doorway, fixing his amber gaze upon the interior where the woman tended the hearth.
Instantly, upon catching sight of the intruder, the woman demanded that he remove himself from her meticulously tidy domain.
She had no desire to harbor an unpredictable creature who refused to contribute to the collective labor of the household.
Rather than retreating into the woods, the cat deployed a calculated strategy of soft persuasion and gentle charm.
He spoke in a low, mesmerizing cadence, proposing a clever bargain that hinged upon a very specific domestic validation.
He promised that if the woman would utter the words 'good cat' just once, he would earn the permanent right to sleep by the fire.
Intrigued by his audacity and swayed by his gentle demeanor, the woman agreed to the curious and unconventional terms.
That very evening, the cat curled himself into a compact shape directly before the hearth, relishing the radiant heat.
He closed his eyes, instantly recognizing the profound comfort of the blazing wood and the soft floor beneath him.
A soft smile crossed the woman's face as she watched the formerly wild creature settle into such absolute tranquility.
The interior remained hushed and harmonious for hours, undisturbed by the anxieties that plagued the untamed wilderness outside.
He expressed his contentment through a deep, rhythmic vibration in his throat that resonated softly in the quiet room.
Sensing a worthy addition to the household, the woman offered him a tender morsel of meat, which he accepted with practiced grace.
When the man returned from his grueling labor in the fields, he paused at the threshold, bewildered by the feline interloper.
The woman patiently recounted the details of their arrangement, explaining the precise terms of the cat's presence.
The man listened intently, nodding slowly as he weighed the practical implications of housing such an independent creature.
He stipulated that if the cat was to remain, he must prove his utility by hunting the troublesome mice that infested the grain stores.
The cat readily assented, pledging his nocturnal services to protect the family's hard-earned provisions from destructive rodents.
Yet, despite his integration into the domestic fold, the cat never truly relinquished the wild instincts of his ancestors.
Whenever the ancient call of the woods reached him through the open air, he would slip out alone into the gathering dusk.
He would prowl through the dew-drenched grass and stalk the shadows, reveling in the untamed freedom of his former life.
However, no matter how far he roamed, the biting chill of severe weather invariably drove him back to the safety of the hearth.
The man and woman always welcomed his return, valuing his silent vigilance against the mice that threatened their winter stores.
Deep within his consciousness, the cat maintained a fierce awareness of his dual identity and his unyielding autonomy.
To him, all places remained fundamentally equal, bridging the vast gulf between the savage woods and the civil hearth.
His existence became a masterclass in balance, teetering delicately between the intoxicating thrill of liberty and the luxury of comfort.
He knew with absolute certainty that he could depart forever at any moment the whim struck his independent mind.
No human authority could ever truly tame his spirit, ensuring that he remained forever the cat who walked by himself.
